title: IM60026: Productivity Analysis And Improvement
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic concepts of productivity, definitions, productivity cycle, phases of
productivity management productivity and organizational performance, issues of
productivity management in manufacturing and service organizations,
organizations for productivity management, productivity measurement and
evaluation models (mathematical and others), performance indices for various
operations, comparative analysis, productivity- profit model, managerial
productivity, productivity planning methodology and its application,
productivity improvement tools and their use, manpower planning for direct and
indirect workforce, theories of human motivation, methods of improving
materials and capital productivity, implementation of productivity projects.
White Collar productivity measurements and evaluation techniques, inter-term
productivity analysis, productivity issues in service sectors, comprehensive
measurement and improvement methodology, performance assessment over time, case
studies, exercises.Books1Production Systems, Planning Analysis and Control,
